style: Dark premium gold-on-charcoal brand system (League Gothic + Montserrat), matching sibling pieces pricing-tiers-reveal / shared-lead-problem / qualified-leads-funnel. One continuous accumulating scene — no hard scene cuts, no blank frames. Chaos-to-order motif: scattered lead-source chips converge into one clean dashboard card.

customize.note: Hand-authored (no catalog block matched the specific 'scattered chips converge into one dashboard card' narrative — searched: 'scattered chips converge into organized dashboard', 'chip stagger reveal', 'dashboard card reveal checklist rows', 'icons scattered rotated converge into single card'). Closest catalog matches (state-chip-rail, radial-surround, stagger-cascade) do the wrong shape of motion (a status rail / radial ring / grid-tile cascade, not scatter-then-single-point-convergence with per-item shrink+fade handoff into rows). Built by hand following the exact convergence pattern already proven in sibling project qualified-leads-funnel (raw-chip -> good-chip handoff at a single point) and shared-lead-problem (icon clone travel via xPercent/yPercent anchor + x/y delta).

chips.label: FORGOTTEN
chips.note: the one that visibly greys out / dissolves early to dramatize 'slipping through the cracks' — never joins the dashboard

decorative_line.method: hand-built div scaleX sweep, width measured from the heading's offsetWidth AFTER document.fonts.ready resolves (plus an immediate synchronous read as fallback) — pattern copied from qualified-leads-funnel's neg-strike measurement, NOT a naive load-time measurement

scenes.motion: slide_top + fade_in, small eyebrow letter-spaced Montserrat, muted color

scenes.text: TEXT MESSAGES / EMAIL / A NOTE ON YOUR DESK / MISSED CALL / FORGOTTEN
scenes.motion: 5 chips scale_punch pop in at scattered/rotated positions staggered ~0.15s apart; FORGOTTEN chip additionally dissolves to near-zero opacity around 4.6-5.3s to dramatize a slipped opportunity

scenes.text: ONE SYSTEM / EVERY LEAD IN ONE PLACE
scenes.motion: dashboard card scale_grow entrance (back.out) at 5.6s; the 4 surviving chips travel to the card's center (shrink+fade), each arrival cross-fades directly into a tidy checklist row inside the card (checkmark draws on) — never a blank instant, the chip and the row overlap
fade_in + slide_bottom caption beneath the now-settled dashboard card, then freeze-hold to end for a clean cut back to host footage
